edits.new:
Scenario: AC5 Boundary (X9)
    Given a statement reaches a v_ace_* view, recovery_case or a foreign schema
    When the grant is checked
    Then the grant refuses it and the boundary test fails the build

  Scenario: AC6 Schedule, data and boundary rules (BR1 to BR10)
    Given the rules BR1 to BR10 of section 8 apply to this service
    When the service is tested
    Then each rule holds as stated in section 8 and tests TC-E4-026-10 to TC-E4-026-17 pass

  Scenario: AC7 Error answers 401, 403 and 404
    Given a request to a provided operation without a valid login
    When the operation is called
    Then the answer is 401
    Given a request to a provided operation by a role lacking the right
    When the operation is called
    Then the answer is 403 with MSG-P4-002 and no read and no write
    Given a request to a provided operation for a case or asset that does not exist
    When the operation is called
    Then the answer is 404

  Scenario: AC8 Replay of a write with the same idempotency key
    Given a write has been applied with an idempotency key
    When the same key is sent again
    Then the write is not repeated, one answer is given and the repeat is counted

  Scenario: AC9 Activity retry and timeout
    Given the rwb-source-data contract mock does not answer within 2 s
    When its trigger arrives
    Then the activity is retried on the workflow schedule and the answer is 503
